attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between lan-a (node2, 10.10.10.0/24 via vtnet1/opt1) and lan-b (node3, 10.10.20.0/24 via vtnet2/opt2), added logged block rules for TCP/23 in both directions in /conf/config.xml's filter section, plus pass rules for other traffic. Verified telnet (port 23) attempts from node2->node3 and node3->node2 are dropped and captured in node1's native pf filter log, while ICMP and SSH (port 22) between the two LANs pass normally. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes: captured a boot-identity/health baseline, restarted each node individually with its native reboot mechanism (acked before disconnect), polled until exec was available again, proved each node's boot identity changed, and re-verified full recovery of interfaces, routes, firewall rules, and the port-23 block+log behavior after each restart. A final end-to-end test after all three restarts reconfirmed a fresh blocked and logged telnet attempt from node2.
